# late.fyi

> Track European trains by email. Email a train number to `<number>@late.fyi` and get updates only when something changes — platform, delay, cancellation, arrival. No accounts, no analytics, no ads; your email address is kept only while a train is tracked and is deleted when the trip ends.

## How it works
- Email a train number (e.g. `ICE145@late.fyi`) with the from/to stations in the subject. Add `On:` for a future date (up to 90 days), `Trip:` to group several trains under one tag.
- Updates arrive by email only when something matters — quiet while the train is on time.
- Stop anytime by replying `STOP` or tapping a STOP mailto link; stopping deletes the trip record and your stored address.

## Privacy
- No accounts, no analytics, no ads, no third parties.
- Your email address lives only in active tracking state and is deleted on terminal (arrival, STOP, or cancellation) — no archive. Operator metrics are aggregate only.
- Open source, Apache 2.0 — auditable end-to-end.

## Links
- [late.fyi](https://late.fyi/): the landing page — what it does and how to send your first train.
- [Source — github.com/hamr0/latefyi](https://github.com/hamr0/latefyi): full implementation, Apache 2.0.
